value.rationale: Complete equivariant topological invariant of a canonical polyhedral graph, not recoverable from known Betti ranks: central inversion acts with eigenspaces 3 and 1 and full rotational invariants vanish. The finite result is mathematically motivated by the complete symmetry group and gives distinct rational homology for natural quotients.
